title: seven of fourteen Entity::form() values are vowel-initial, and two shipped messages glue a bare 'a' in front of them -- facade.rs:715 says "A `issue` has no files of its own" and facade.rs:4396 builds "a issue address"; the article belongs with the noun, as IdKind::with_article now does
body:
**RESTORED ARCHAEOLOGY, TRANSCRIBED VERBATIM ON 2026-08-31.** This issue was filed with an empty body because no verb could write one -- the defect `0090` names -- so its finding survived only in the commit that filed it. The prose below is its author's, carried whole from `53f92bbf` (*issues(0081): seven of fourteen form() values are vowel-initial and two shipped messages glue a bare article on*). **Nothing in it is written by the restorer**; the header you are reading is the only addition, and the commit's hard line wraps are joined without a word changed.

Filed at low severity. The whole finding is in the title because `issues add` takes a title and a severity only -- `Issue.body` is a declared field neither door can write, which is AC-08.5's denominator met in the ordinary course of work.

Also carries the three ST0056 row texts into vc's inbox: AC-06.12, AT-06.12 and EXP-10. vc holds ST0056 and does the canon write; serialising through one hand removes the race.
